summary: Historical integrity belongs to stages/post/gates/historical-integrity with executionClass governance-audit, may use schedule, manual and affected-path triggers, and must never leave the v3-historical-integrity required check pending on a PR.
rationale: User answer to Plan 06 D8. The gate produces blocking validation, so it is a Post gate, but its trigger profile differs from code gates. A required check that never reports would block merging, which section 10.3 forbids. Plan 06 section 17 D8.
